verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's docs describe browser automation (click, fill forms, navigate) and a 'Browser Sandbox' for interactive workflows, suggesting the agent can traverse form walls, and community comments reference paid tiers with a fixed number of 'solves' per day and proxy usage implying built-in CAPTCHA handling. However, there is no explicit vendor claim of autonomous CAPTCHA-solving or login automation, and community feedback notes missing proxy support and other limitations, so full unattended bypass isn't clearly documented.
